categories.description_en: Left and right crankcase halves and related crankcase assemblies machined to OEM mounting and bearing tolerances.

categories.description_en: Clutch covers, magneto covers, and protective engine cover assemblies verified against OEM mating interfaces.
categories.description_zh: 离合器盖、磁电机盖及其他发动机盖件。按发动机代码与接口资料核对匹配。

categories.description_en: Complete aftermarket replacement engine assemblies built to OEM mounting and shaft specifications for direct distributor and fleet supply.
categories.description_zh: 按原厂安装接口、花键与传动规格制造的整机替换总成，支持与国产 CG/CB/水冷三轮整机同柜混装出口。

categories.description_en: Precision-bored cylinder blocks, pistons, rings, cylinder heads, and rocker assemblies matched to target OEM displacements.
categories.description_zh: 按目标原厂排量与气道结构匹配的套缸活塞组件、缸头总成与气门摇臂部件。

categories.description_en: Forged crankshaft connecting-rod assemblies, silent timing chains, and tensioners for high-mileage commuter and 3-wheeler fleets.
categories.description_zh: 高里程商用两轮与三轮车型专用的锻造曲轴连杆总成、正时链条及涨紧器组件。

categories.name_zh: 离合器与传动/倒挡齿轮
categories.description_en: Clutch assemblies, friction plates, primary/counter transmission shafts, shift drums, and 3-wheeler reverse gear sets.
categories.description_zh: 重载离合器总成、摩擦片、主副轴传动齿轮、变速鼓拨叉及三轮车倒挡齿轮组。

categories.name_zh: 全车大修包 / 密封垫片包
categories.description_en: Complete engine overhaul gasket kits and oil seal sets for field maintenance and distributor service stock.
categories.description_zh: 适用于售后整机大修的全套密封垫片包、油封包及边盖密封件。

model_hubs.model_name_zh: Bajaj Boxer CT100 / Boxer BM100 商用两轮平台
model_hubs.engine_code: CT100 / BM100 OHC (DU10 / DD10 / PF Ref.)
model_hubs.summary_en: Built to Indian OEM 4-stroke air-cooled SOHC architecture (99.27 cc classic spec: 6.03 kW / 8.2 PS @ 7,500 rpm, 8.05 N·m @ 4,500 rpm, 9.5:1 compression, 4-speed constant mesh, 1.0 L oil capacity, 428-14T sprocket). Available both as complete replacement engines and as core overhaul castings/kits, consolidated in mixed containers with Chinese CG/CB engines.
model_hubs.summary_zh: 严格对标印度原厂四冲程风冷顶置凸轮轴（OHC）平台规格（经典 99.27 cc 版：53.0×45.0 mm，6.03 kW / 8.2 PS @ 7,500 rpm，8.05 N·m @ 4,500 rpm，压缩比 9.5:1，国际 4 挡常啮合，脚启动，机油容量 1.0 L，428-14T 输出链轮；另可按单确认 102 cc 长行程 47.0×58.8 mm 版）。支持整机总成及重点核心件出口，并可与中国 CG/CB 整机同柜混装发运。
